## Goal
- Retrieve the full list of liked songs from the user's Spotify account.
- Understand available Spotify APIs related to queue, liked songs, and player control.
- Remove liked songs from the current Spotify song queue.
- Start playback of the music player after queue modification.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use Spotify API with proper authentication (access token).
- Handle pagination when fetching liked songs.
- Use the provided Spotify account email and password for login.
- When removing songs from the queue, use the 0-indexed position parameter as required by the API, not the song_id.
- Remove songs from the queue starting from the highest position to avoid index shifting issues.
